question: What becomes the object of awareness for one who desires no result?
premises: A person of full heart does not desire any fruit.
Without desire for a limited result, there is no need to fix on a limited form.
By abandoning limitation, the goddess appears as the totality of all forms.
inference: For the desireless person of full heart, the whole universe as the goddess becomes the living reality, without restrictive focus.
plain_english: But one whose heart is full desires no result at all; for him, because limitation has been abandoned, the goddess appears as the form of the entire universe.
